summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund S, a non-listed BDC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of 81,237 common shares at $24.25 NAV per share for $1.97 million as of September 1, 2026. The filing also declared a $0.1667 September distribution (net $0.1498) payable October 30, 2026, and disclosed portfolio commentary: 171 companies, $249 million fair value, 98% first-lien. This is ordinary interval-fund capital activity, not a special situation.
